aggregations.description: HMDA counts and total loan amounts (dollars) for one geography kind (states, counties or msamds; exactly one), one row per year x place x combination of the filter values asked. The pack sends one call per year and place (the API sums a list into one figure) and checks that every filter was applied. At most two filters: actions_taken and one more.

years.desc: HMDA activity year, 2018 on (the latest year is published each spring): one, a list or a range ("2018-2024"); the pack sends one call per year

states.desc: two-letter state or territory codes (one or a list); one call per state

counties.desc: 5-digit state+county FIPS codes (one or a list); one call per county

msamds.desc: 5-digit MSA or metropolitan division codes (one or a list); for the largest metro areas use the division codes; one call per code

actions_taken.desc: required. 1 originated, 2 approved not accepted, 3 denied, 4 withdrawn, 5 closed incomplete, 6 purchased loan, 7 preapproval denied, 8 preapproval approved not accepted; one or a list (each value gets its own rows)

loan_types.desc: 1 conventional, 2 FHA-insured, 3 VA-guaranteed, 4 USDA RHS or FSA-guaranteed; one or a list

loan_purposes.desc: 1 home purchase, 2 home improvement, 31 refinancing, 32 cash-out refinancing, 4 other, 5 not applicable; one or a list

loan_products.desc: loan type and lien, e.g. 'Conventional:First Lien', 'FHA:First Lien', 'VA:First Lien', 'FSA/RHS:First Lien', 'Conventional:Subordinate Lien'

races.desc: derived race of the applicants, e.g. 'White', 'Black or African American', 'Asian', 'Joint', 'Race Not Available'

ethnicities.desc: derived ethnicity: 'Hispanic or Latino', 'Not Hispanic or Latino', 'Joint', 'Ethnicity Not Available'
